biography.value:
Description

The legendary dragon of wind and storms has returned but with greater power. He moves like the wind and is really hard to hit.

Defense

AC 39, touch 24, flat-footed 21 (+15 natural, +17 dex, +1 dodge, -4 size)

hp 1363 [1682] (29d12+493)

mp 257

Fort +32, Ref +35, Will +28

Absorb Wind

DR 15/magic

Immune Ability Drain, Berserk, Charmed, Confuse, Cowering, Death, Diseased, Doom, Energy Drain, Entangled, Exhausted, Fatigued, Frightened, Frog, Immobilized, Imperil, Mini, Nauseated, Panicked, Paralysis, Petrification/Statue, Poison, Shaken, Silence, Sleep, Slow, Staggered, Stop, Stunned, Zombie

Resist earth 50%

SR 34

Weakness Lightning

Offense

Speed 60 ft., fly 240 ft. (clumsy)

Melee Bite +39 (4d6+21), 2 claws +39 (2d8+14), 2 wings +37 (2d6+7), tail slap +37 (2d8+21)

Space 20 ft.; Reach 15 ft.(20 ft. with bite)

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (70-ft. cone, 24d10 wind damage, Reflex DC 37 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Crush (medium creatures, DC 37, 4d6+21), Leaf Swirl, Maelstrom, tail sweep (small creatures, DC 37, 2d6+21), Wind Slash

Spells Known (FC CL 29th, Concentration +39)

At will (DC 20) - detect magic, mending, message, read magic

1st (DC 21) - aero, wind armor, wind runner, wind shield

2nd (DC 22) - aero II, wind barrier

3rd (DC 23) - area, aero III, battering blast, cloak of winds, wind wall

4th (DC 24) - aero IV, air walk, freedom of movement, hurricane blast, river of wind

5th (DC 25) - aeroga, slice

6th (DC 26) - tornado, wind walk

7th (DC 27) - control weather, souring winds

8th (DC 28) - tornado II, whirlwind

9th (DC 29) - winds of vengeance

Statistics

Str 38, Dex 44, Con 42, Int 20, Wis 30, Cha 20

Base Atk +29; CMB +48; CMD 77 (81 vs. trip)

Feats Canny Tumble, Cleave, Dodge, Great Cleave, Iron Will, Juke, Lightning Reflexes, Mobility, Multiattack, Osyluth Guile, Power Attack, Redirect Attack, Sidestep, Toughness, Wind Stance

Skills Acrobatics +46, Appraise +37, Bluff +37, Diplomacy +37, Intimidate +37, Fly +51, Knowledge (arcana) +37, Knowledge (nature) +37, Perception +42, Spellcraft +37, Stealth +49, Survival +42, Use Magic Device +27; Racial Modifiers +8 Fly

Languages Auran, Common, Draconic +3 others

SQ 25% concealment vs magical/physical attacks, Auto-Float, Beatdown

[phase i] Storm Dragon is always hovering. This gives it movement as though it was under the effect of a float spell; this effect cannot be dispelled.

description.value: [phase i] Once every 1d2+1 rounds as a full round action the Storm Dragon can choose to do this effect twice since it reacts really quickly. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 8th level spell (DC 31).

description.value: [Phase II] Once every 1d2+1 rounds as a standard action, Storm Dragon strikes multiple times with great power towards one opponent within melee range. If he hits (+39/+34/+29), this attack does 4d6+21 points of slashing/piercing damage per successful hit.

effect: [Phase II] Once every 1d2+1 rounds as a standard action, Storm Dragon strikes multiple times with great power towards one opponent within melee range. If he hits (+39/+34/+29), this attack does 4d6+21 points of slashing/piercing damage per successful hit.

description.value: [Phase II] Once every 1d4+1 rounds as a full-round action, Storm Dragon can unleash a black, draining wind upon his enemies. All enemies in a 20 ft. radius burst, with a range of 30 feet, must make a Fortitude save (DC 34) or be reduced to a number of hit points equal to their HD. Those who are already at such a level of hit points or lower are reduced to 1 hit point instead. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 9th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 33).
